text:
1. Take complete ownership of the situation and follow up.

2. The first attempt to retain the customer is always a phone call, not an email, unless the customer asks.

3. Choosing the correct ticket status.

4. Correct Team and Queue assignment based on the situation/flow until we get a response/update from/to the customer.

5. Attempt to resolve the issue, de-escalate the situation, and proactively identify the necessary actions to take.

6. Providing the customer with a response/resolution during the live interaction, not postponing it to a follow-up email.

7. Sending a confirmation email after the live interaction with the full needed information (Membership Cancelation, Order Cancelation, Membership Pause, Applying the discount, etc..).

8. Knowledge Base Utilization: Use all available tools/resources and validate information on Confluence/Slack before escalating the ticket.
